cohort: Women who experienced a life-threatening complication during pregnancy, childbirth, or within six weeks postpartum at a tertiary care center in Karur district, Tamil Nadu, India, between January 2023 and December 2023.
finding: The MNM incidence ratio was 19.3 per 1000 live births, and the MNM mortality ratio was 25.3:1, with hemorrhage and eclampsia being the leading causes of MNM.
